myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Mama Quilla appears in incan tradition as moon, marriage. The name's meaning, "Mother moon", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Mama Quilla in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Mama Quilla remains a touchstone for understanding incan religion, art, and identity.
